title: Build a progression
body: Set a key, a tempo and up to sixteen bars. Enter chords one at a time or start from a sample. Each chord shows its function in the key.

title: Find scales and notes
body: Tap a chord to see the scales and arpeggios that fit, the feel of each, and the guide tones that lead into the next chord.

title: Write your melody
body: Write in tabs or sheet music. Notes that fit are checked, notes outside the scale are marked. Nothing is ever removed for you.

title: Ask for autofill
body: Stuck on a bar? Copilot proposes a short phrase with the theory behind it. Accept it, edit it, or throw it away.
